name: GridPixl Elements for Elementor
author: GridPixl

sections.description:
GridPixl Elements adds a set of carefully crafted Elementor widgets designed for performance, clean design, and flexible controls.

The plugin is designed to work seamlessly with Elementor and provides commonly used content elements with extended styling and layout options, without adding unnecessary overhead.

Included Widgets

The following widgets are included in this version:

  • Heading
  • Button
  • Icon Box
  • Info Card
  • Icon List
  • Basic Accordion
  • Social Icons
  • Progress Bar
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the Elementor plugin.
  2. Upload the GridPixl Elements plugin.
  3. Activate GridPixl Elements from the Plugins menu.
  4. Open Elementor and find the widgets under the GridPixl Elements section.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes. Elementor must be installed and activated for GridPixl Elements to work.

Is Elementor Pro required?

No. GridPixl Elements works with the free version of Elementor.

Is this plugin optimized for performance?

Yes. The plugin is built with a lightweight approach and only loads assets when required.
